metadata.source: All stats sourced from the DDO Wiki (https://ddowiki.com).

scope.Stoner81 Leveling Guide: Every named item at every referenced level (L1-32), including the L30 Legendary set and item swaps; plus Cannith/Essence-crafted pieces.
scope.Lominal Intelligence Build: All gear pieces (Legendary/endgame L30-34 versions). scope.Lominal Inquisitive Guide: Only the Slaughtering Shot weapon plus the filigrees and augments (no other gear).

decisions: Essence-crafted items (system formerly named Cannith Crafting) included with a link to the Essence Crafting page and target affixes (no unique item page exists). Category value is 'essence_crafted'.
Augments and filigrees included as full entries.

resolved_notes: Lominal Intelligence and Inquisitive gear are Legendary endgame (L30-34) versions, confirmed by user.
Epic Ethereal Ring (ML20) and Epic Quiver of Alacrity (ML20) DO have dedicated wiki pages and are now fully sourced.
Feycraft / Magecraft are confirmed armor base MATERIALS (random-loot blanks) used as Essence Crafting bases; the 'Fearsome' etc. are crafted onto them.
'Raid RP' confirmed by user as the Ranged Power (Raid) filigree (Spines of the Manticore / The Wreath of Flame).
Filigrees expanded to the individual filigrees Lominal's Inquisitive guide actually slots (per the parenthetical tags: RP, to hit+dmg, reflex save, Deception), each tied to its set's bonus tiers.
Every set-bearing item/filigree now carries a 'set_bonus' field stating the set name, piece-count thresholds, and stats granted (sourced from DDO Wiki).

AUDIT 2026-05-31: Full guide-vs-data reconciliation passed. Added 2 Lominal Inquisitive (Layout 1) augments that were missing — Diamond of Constitution +14 (ML32) and Diamond of Insightful Constitution +5 (ML24). The audit's 3rd flagged item ('Dexterity +8' on the Celestial Sapphire Ring) was a FALSE POSITIVE: it is one of the ring's randomly-rolled enhancements, already captured in that item's entry, not a slottable augment — so no augment was added for it. Added Lash, the Arbalest of Arcs (the previously-excluded repeater) as a tagged end-game respec/BiS reference; its filigrees and augments stay excluded.

WEAPON RECATEGORIZATION 2026-05-31: A weapon-type scan verified all 16 weapons/rune-arms against the DDO Wiki 'Weapon Type' field (every type was already correct). Previously only the 2 Lominal weapons were category 'weapon' while the other 14 sat in 'item'/'essence_crafted'/'dinosaur_bone_crafted', so weapon filtering surfaced only those 2. All 16 are now category 'weapon' with a normalized, wiki-correct weapon-type slot (Light Crossbow / Heavy Crossbow / Repeating Heavy Crossbow / Rune Arm), so they group cleanly in the filter. The original crafting system (Essence / Dinosaur Bone) is preserved in each affected entry's notes. Net category counts: 78 item, 49 augment, 16 weapon, 16 essence_crafted, 10 filigree, 0 dinosaur_bone_crafted = 169 total.

SLOT TAXONOMY 2026-05-31: (1) Rune arms split out of 'weapon' into their own category 'runearm' (7 entries; slot 'Rune Arm'). (2) Every worn gear item normalized to a single canonical DDO equipment slot — Armor, Helmet, Goggles, Necklace, Trinket, Cloak, Belt, Ring, Gloves, Boots, Bracers, Quiver — replacing the old dual-form strings ('Head / Helm', 'Finger / Ring', etc.). Weapons keep their weapon-type slot; augments keep their gem-color slot; filigrees keep their sentient-weapon slot. (3) The 12 situational swap items from Stoner's 'Item Swaps' sections (incl. Necklace of Bottled Sunlight, per user) now use slot 'Swappable' — they are bag items used situationally then swapped back; each item's real worn slot is preserved in its notes ('Worn slot: ...'). Final category counts: 78 item, 49 augment, 16 weapon, 16 essence_crafted, 10 filigree, 7 runearm = 169 total.

crafting_and_augment_compatibility.essence_crafting: Cannith Crafting was renamed Essence Crafting (Update 79). Crafted entries use category 'essence_crafted' and link to https://ddowiki.com/page/Essence_Crafting. Each blank has a prefix + suffix slot, plus an optional 3rd 'extra' effect via a Mark of House Cannith (only on ML10+ items) — consistent with every 3-effect crafted item here being ML10+. Insightful effects are first practical at ML10, matching the guide.
crafting_and_augment_compatibility.augment_slots_are_inherited: Essence Crafting does NOT add augment slots. Augment slots (and slotted augments) come from the random-loot blank and persist through disjunction. The augment_slots listed on crafted items are therefore 'pick a blank that has this slot', not crafted.

standard_color_compatibility.gem_naming: Colorless=Diamond, Red=Ruby, Yellow=Topaz, Blue=Sapphire, Green=Emerald, Orange=Citrine, Purple=Amethyst

crafting_and_augment_compatibility.special_slots_are_separate_systems: These slots on the endgame items do NOT accept standard color augments and are not interchangeable with them: (1) Sun / Moon slots = the Sun & Moon Augment system — the guides' 'Solar gems / Lunar gems'. (2) Lamordia: Melancholic / Dolorous / Miserable / Woeful slots = Viktranium Experiment crafting augments (removed with a Viktranium Pick) — e.g. Lominal's 'dolorous flames', 'miserable improved destruction'. (3) Dinosaur Bone Bone/Claw/Fang/Scale/Set-Bonus slots = Dinosaur Bone crafting augments (e.g. Meltscale, Meltfang, Brightclaw) removed with a Bonepicker. The 49 standard augments in this database fill the standard color slots only.
crafting_and_augment_compatibility.note_on_this_database: All 49 augment entries are standard color or named augments and their slot color is the gem's native color (it also fits any compound slot containing that color per the matrix above). The guides' 'Solar/Lunar gems', dino effects, and Lamordia weapon/armor effects are the special-system augments and are recorded inside the relevant items' enhancements/slots rather than as standalone standard-augment entries.

essence_crafting_verification.rule: Essence Crafting = 1 prefix + 1 suffix, plus an optional 3rd 'extra' effect via a Mark of House Cannith (extra slot is ML10+ only). Insightful effects require ML10+. Each effect can only be crafted into specific prefix/suffix/extra positions for a given gear slot (verified against DDO Wiki: Essence_Crafting/table_1b). Augments and the auto-applied Enhancement Bonus / weapon dice are separate and are not counted as crafted affixes.
essence_crafting_verification.result: PASS — all 17 originally Essence-crafted entries conform (each uses 2-3 crafted effects in legal, distinct prefix/suffix/extra positions; every 3-effect item is ML10+; all Insightful effects on ML10+ items). NOTE (2026-05-31): the Cannith Crafted Heavy Repeating Crossbow was recategorized to category 'weapon' for weapon filtering, so the live 'essence_crafted' category now holds the 16 non-weapon crafted pieces; the repeater remains Essence-crafted in mechanics, flagged in its notes.
